description: Linux kernel userspace tools, built from the kernel source tree; this package installs nothing itself and suggests the split tool packages

bootconfig.description: Apply, delete or show the boot configuration (bootconfig) appended to an initrd

bpf.description: BPF tools: bpftool to inspect and manage eBPF programs and maps, plus bpf_asm, bpf_dbg and bpf_jit_disasm

cpupower.description: Examine and tune processor power saving features: frequency scaling governors, idle states and energy bias

hyperv.description: Hyper-V guest integration daemons (key-value pair exchange, VSS snapshots, file copy) and lsvmbus

intel-speed-select.description: Configure Intel Speed Select Technology (performance profiles, base and turbo frequency, core power) on supported Xeon processors

kcpuid.description: Show the processor features reported by the CPUID instruction

tmon.description: Monitor and test the Linux kernel thermal subsystem: temperatures, cooling devices and trip points

turbostat.description: Report processor frequency, idle state residency, temperature and power on x86 processors

usbip.description: Share USB devices over an IP network: the usbip client, the usbipd server and libusbip

x86_energy_perf_policy.description: Read or set the energy versus performance policy of Intel processors (EPB, EPP and HWP settings)
